title: Beginning with a Summer Day
overview: Childhood buddies Hayato and Haruki are reunited when Hayato moves to Tokyo and sees Haruki at his new school.

title: I Really Suck at Girl Talk
overview: As the two old friends continue to get reacquainted, Haruki starts teasing Hayato for not owning a cell phone.

title: Produced by Himeko
overview: Himeko meets Haruki for the first time in years and decides to take her shopping to help update her wardrobe.

title: Small Hands, Broad Shoulders
overview: Hayato and Haruki go phone shopping together and then Haruki ends up spending the night at Hayato's apartment.

title: Discipline, Young Maiden
overview: Himeko and Haruki decide to go on a diet, so Hayato starts asking friends for health-conscious recipe ideas.

title: What About Your Camouflage!?
overview: Hayato steps in when he sees Kazuki trying to make a move on Haruki, who keeps dropping her nice girl facade.

title: You're Special
overview: Hayato visits his mother in the hospital and then makes plans with Haruki and Himeko to go somewhere together.

title: Where the Heart Is
overview: Hayato, Haruki, and Himeko go to the movies as planned but end up catching an unexpected guest along the way.

title: Truly Special
overview: Haruki opens up about family issues after her rough night and Kazuki keeps trying to stir up drama at school.
